description: This file contains an extension for CanvasWindowController, providing methods to create, present, reposition, and manage the frame of windows/panels in a macOS application, specifically for CanvasPresentation display modes.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and returns an NSWindow or CanvasPanel based on the presentation type (window or panel) with specified content view.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Displays the panel, repositioning it based on an anchor provider, and activates it.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Calculates and sets the panel's frame based on anchor point, screen info, previous frame, and preferred placement.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates the default top-right frame for the panel on a given screen.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of the panel, constraining it within visible screen bounds, and persists the position if applicable.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines which screen contains a given anchor rect.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Returns the screen where the mouse cursor currently resides.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a given frame intersects visibly with a specified screen.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Adjusts a frame to ensure it fits within a visible bounds rect.

methods.name: windowWillClose
methods.description: Delegate method called when window is about to close; triggers visibility change callback.

methods.name: windowDidMove
methods.description: Delegate method to persist frame after window move.

methods.name: windowDidEndLiveResize
methods.description: Delegate method to persist frame after window resize.

methods.name: persistFrameIfPanel
methods.description: Stores the current frame if the window is a panel.
